# Update the note content by replacing TODO markers with release months.
import re

def replace_todo(match):
    title = match.group(1)
    artists = match.group(2)
    month = release_months.get(title, "TODO")
    return f"- {title} BY {artists} RELEASED_AT {month}"

updated_content = re.sub(
    r"- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO",
    replace_todo,
    content
)

# Show the updated content to verify.
print(updated_content)
